definition.name: codebase_about
definition.description: Display information about SocratiCode — what it is, its tools and how to use it. Use this to get a quick overview of the MCP tools and their purpose.

definition.name: codebase_context
definition.description: List all context artifacts defined in .socraticodecontextartifacts.json — database schemas, API specs, infra configs, architecture docs, etc. Shows each artifact's name, description, path, and index status. Use this to discover what project knowledge is available beyond source code.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory. If omitted, uses the current working directory.

definition.name: codebase_context_index
definition.description: Index or re-index all context artifacts defined in .socraticodecontextartifacts.json. Chunks and embeds artifact content into the vector database for semantic search. Usually not needed — codebase_context_search auto-indexes on first use.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

definition.name: codebase_context_remove
definition.description: Remove all indexed context artifacts for a project from the vector database. Blocked while indexing is in progress — use codebase_stop or wait for the operation to finish first.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

definition.name: codebase_context_search
definition.description: Semantic search across context artifacts (database schemas, API specs, infra configs, etc.) defined in .socraticodecontextartifacts.json. Auto-indexes on first use and auto-detects stale artifacts. Use this to find relevant infrastructure or domain knowledge.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g. 'tables related to billing', 'authentication endpoints', 'deployment resource limits').

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

artifactName.description: Filter search to a specific artifact by name (e.g. 'database-schema'). Omit to search across all artifacts.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10.

minScore.description: Minimum RRF score threshold (0-1). Results below this are filtered out. Default: 0.10 (override globally via SEARCH_MIN_SCORE env var). Set to 0 to disable filtering.

definition.name: codebase_flow
definition.description: Trace the EXECUTION FLOW forward from an entry point — what does this code call into? With NO args, returns a ranked list of auto-detected entry points (orphans with outgoing calls, conventional names like main(), framework routes, tests). With an entrypoint argument, returns the call tree.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

entrypoint.description: Symbol name to trace from. Omit to list auto-detected entry points.

file.description: Optional file hint to disambiguate the symbol.

depth.description: Maximum DFS depth (default 5, max 10).

limit.description: Maximum candidates to list when the entrypoint is ambiguous. Omit to list all.

definition.name: codebase_graph_build
definition.description: Build a dependency graph of the codebase using static analysis (ast-grep). Maps import/require/export relationships between files. Runs in the background — call codebase_graph_status to poll progress until complete.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

extraExtensions.description: Comma-separated list of additional file extensions to include in the graph (e.g. '.tpl,.blade'). Files with non-standard extensions are included as leaf nodes (dependency targets). Can also be set globally via EXTRA_EXTENSIONS env var.

definition.name: codebase_graph_circular
definition.description: Find circular dependencies in the codebase.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

definition.name: codebase_graph_query
definition.description: Query the code dependency graph for a specific file. Returns what the file imports and what files depend on it.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

filePath.description: Relative path of the file to query (e.g. 'src/index.ts').

definition.name: codebase_graph_remove
definition.description: Remove a project's persisted code graph. Waits for any in-flight graph build to finish first. The graph can be rebuilt with codebase_graph_build or will be rebuilt automatically on the next codebase_index.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

definition.name: codebase_graph_stats
definition.description: Get statistics about the code dependency graph: total files, edges, most connected files, orphan files, circular dependencies.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

definition.name: codebase_graph_status
definition.description: Check the status of the code dependency graph: build progress (if building), node/edge count, when it was last built, whether it's cached in memory. Use this to poll progress after calling codebase_graph_build.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

definition.name: codebase_graph_visualize
definition.description:
Visualise the code dependency graph. Two modes:
  • mode="mermaid" (default) — returns a Mermaid diagram (text) colour-coded by language, circular deps highlighted. Best for inline rendering inside chat, GitHub, or editors that render Mermaid.
  • mode="interactive" — writes a self-contained HTML page (vendored Cytoscape.js + Dagre, works offline) and opens it in the user's default browser. Shows the file graph and, when a symbol graph is available and fits, a Symbols toggle with the symbol-level call graph. Interactions: click node for sidebar with imports/dependents/symbols list; right-click node to highlight its blast radius (reverse-transitive closure); live search; layout switcher (Dagre / force / concentric / breadth-first / grid / circle); PNG export. Use this when the user asks for a visual/interactive view, wants to explore visually, or needs a shareable diagram.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

mode.description: "mermaid" (default — text diagram) or "interactive" (browser-based explorer).

open.description: In interactive mode, whether to auto-open the browser. Default true. Set false to just get the file path (useful in headless environments).

definition.name: codebase_health
definition.description: Check the health of all infrastructure: Docker, Qdrant container, Ollama, and embedding model. Use this to diagnose setup issues.

definition.name: codebase_impact
definition.description: Impact Analysis — return the BLAST RADIUS for a file or symbol. Lists every file (and, where helpful, function) that could break if you change the target. Polymorphic on target: a path-like string ('src/foo.ts') triggers file-mode; a name-like string ('validateUser') triggers symbol-mode. Use this BEFORE refactoring, renaming, or deleting code to know what depends on it.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

target.description: Target file path (relative) OR symbol name.

file.description: Optional file path to disambiguate the target symbol.

depth.description: How many hops back to walk (default 3, max 10).

limit.description: Maximum candidates to list when the target symbol is ambiguous. Omit to list all.

definition.name: codebase_index
definition.description: Start indexing a codebase in the background. Returns immediately. Call codebase_status to poll progress until 100%. Do NOT search until indexing is complete. If already indexing, returns current progress.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory. If omitted, uses the current working directory.

extraExtensions.description: Comma-separated list of additional file extensions to index beyond the built-in set (e.g. '.tpl,.blade,.hbs'). Useful for projects with non-standard file extensions. Can also be set globally via EXTRA_EXTENSIONS env var.

definition.name: codebase_list_projects
definition.description: List all projects that have been indexed (have collections in Qdrant).

definition.name: codebase_prune
definition.description: Inventory stored project identities and their resources. Report-only by default. Applying requires an exact identity, the confirmation token from a fresh inventory, and an acknowledgement that no other host is writing to it; path absence on this host is advisory, not proof of abandonment.

apply.description: Delete the selected identity only when true. Omit for the report-only inventory.

confirmationToken.description: Opaque token returned for that identity by codebase_prune.

acknowledgeNoRemoteWriters.description: Required with apply. Locks on this host cannot see another host sharing the same Qdrant; true states that none is writing to this identity.

definition.name: codebase_remove
definition.description: Remove a project's codebase index entirely from the vector database. Safely stops the file watcher, cancels any in-progress indexing/update (with drain), and waits for any in-flight graph build before deleting.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

definition.name: codebase_search
definition.description: Semantic search across an indexed codebase. Only use after codebase_index is complete (check codebase_status first). Returns relevant code chunks matching a natural language query.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g. 'authentication middleware', 'database connection setup').

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10 (override globally via SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT env var).

fileFilter.description: Filter results to a specific file path (relative).

languageFilter.description: Filter results to a specific language (e.g. 'typescript', 'python').

minScore.description: Minimum RRF score threshold (0-1). Results below this are filtered out. Default: 0.10 (override globally via SEARCH_MIN_SCORE env var). Set to 0 to disable filtering.

includeLinked.description: When true, also search across linked projects defined in .socraticode.json or SOCRATICODE_LINKED_PROJECTS env var. Results include a project label showing which project each result came from. Default: false.

definition.name: codebase_status
definition.description: Check index status: chunk count, indexing progress (%), last completed operation, file watcher state. Call after codebase_index to poll until 100% complete.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

definition.name: codebase_stop
definition.description: Gracefully stop an in-progress indexing operation. The current batch will finish and checkpoint, preserving all progress. Re-run codebase_index to resume from where it left off.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory. If omitted, uses the current working directory.

definition.name: codebase_symbol
definition.description: 360° view of a symbol: definition, kind, callers, callees, confidence levels. Use to understand a function or class before changing it.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

name.description: Symbol name (e.g. 'validateUser').

file.description: Optional file hint to disambiguate when the name is not unique.

limit.description: Maximum definitions to resolve when the name is not unique. Omit to resolve all.

definition.name: codebase_symbols
definition.description: List symbols in a file, or search by name across the project. Use to discover what exists before drilling into a single symbol with codebase_symbol.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

file.description: Relative file path — list all symbols in this file.

query.description: Substring to match against symbol names project-wide.

definition.name: codebase_update
definition.description: Incrementally update an existing codebase index. Only re-indexes changed files. Runs synchronously. Use it to refresh a manual/off snapshot, working-tree edits before the next Git transition in git mode, or whenever an immediate catch-up is needed.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

extraExtensions.description: Comma-separated list of additional file extensions to index (e.g. '.tpl,.blade').

definition.name: codebase_watch
definition.description: Start/stop watching a project directory for file changes and automatically update the index. When starting, first runs an incremental update to catch up, then watches for changes. SOCRATICODE_WATCHER=manual allows explicit starts only; off and git reject file-watcher starts. In git mode, status reports Git refresh state and stop does not disable Git checks.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

action.description: start/stop watching, or get status of watchers.

definition.name: close-session
definition.description: Close a named session. A background session's command is signalled on the host (INT, then TERM, then KILL) before its channel is dropped; an interactive session's shell is ended. The response says so if the command could not be signalled or had not stopped in time.

name.description: Session name to close

profile.description: Profile name

definition.name: list-connections
definition.description: List all configured SSH profiles and their connection status. Use this to discover available hosts before running commands.

definition.name: list-sessions
definition.description: List active sessions for a given SSH profile.

profile.description: Profile name (uses default if omitted)

definition.name: open-session
definition.description: Open a named session on a remote host. Use type="interactive" for stateful shell (CWD/env persists between commands) or type="background" for long-running processes.

name.description: Session name (alphanumeric, dash, underscore, max 64 chars)

command.description: Command for background sessions

profile.description: Profile name (uses default if omitted)

definition.name: privileged-command
definition.description: Execute a command with sudo elevation. Goes through the approval gate; approvalPolicy on the profile decides whether that is a prompt, an automatic allow, or a refusal. The sudo password is piped via stdin for the prompt only (never visible in process list); the command itself runs with stdin at /dev/null, so it can never read the password back. Single-line only: a command containing a line break is refused, so upload a multi-line script with sftp-upload and run it by path.

command.description: Command to execute with sudo

profile.description: Profile name

definition.name: read-command
definition.description: Execute a READ-ONLY command from an allowlist (ls, cat, grep, find, stat, df, etc.). This tool does NOT modify the system. Prefer this tool for all read operations. Single-line only: a command containing a line break is refused, so upload a multi-line script with sftp-upload and run it by path.

command.description: Read-only shell command (must be in the allowlist)

profile.description: Profile name

definition.name: read-session-output
definition.description: Read recent output from a background session (e.g., tail -f logs).

name.description: Background session name

lines.description: Number of recent lines to read

profile.description: Profile name

definition.name: reload-config
definition.description: Report or reload the server's config file. action="status" (the default) shows the config path, when it was loaded, the sha256 of its bytes and the result of the last reload; never the contents. action="reload" re-reads the file, validates it exactly as startup does, and applies it only if every check passes; a refused reload changes nothing. Command-line flags are never reloaded. Applying closes connections, with their sessions, whose profile was removed or whose connection fields changed, and clears approval grants.

action.description: "status" (default) reports the loaded config; "reload" re-reads and applies the file

definition.name: run-command
definition.description: Execute an arbitrary shell command on the remote server. May modify the system. Commands classified destructive or privileged go through the approval gate; approvalPolicy on the profile decides whether that is a prompt, an automatic allow, or a refusal. Single-line only: a command containing a line break is refused, so upload a multi-line script with sftp-upload and run it by path.

command.description: Shell command to execute

profile.description: Profile name

session.description: Run in an existing interactive session (stateful)

definition.name: sftp-download
definition.description: Download a file from the remote server via SFTP.

remotePath.description: Remote file path. No leading or trailing whitespace, and no control, bidirectional or zero-width characters: the approval prompt and the audit record quote this path back.

profile.description: Profile name

definition.name: sftp-download-file
definition.description: Download a remote file to local disk over SFTP, streaming it without passing the contents through model context. The destination must be inside the transferRoot directory the operator configured; without that setting this tool refuses. Use this for binary or large files; use sftp-download when you need to read the contents.

remotePath.description: Remote file to download. No leading or trailing whitespace, and no control, bidirectional or zero-width characters.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing local file (default false)

profile.description: Profile name

definition.name: sftp-list
definition.description: List a remote directory over SFTP, with a bounded number of entries and a bounded response size. Read-only.

remotePath.description: Remote directory to list. No leading or trailing whitespace, and no control, bidirectional or zero-width characters.

maxEntries.description: Max entries to return (default 200, hard cap 1000)

profile.description: Profile name

definition.name: sftp-upload
definition.description: Upload a file to the remote server via SFTP (secure file transfer, not shell-based). Replaces an existing file at that path unconditionally — there is no overwrite flag and no way to require a new destination.

remotePath.description: Remote file path. No leading or trailing whitespace, and no control, bidirectional or zero-width characters: the approval prompt and the audit record quote this path back.

profile.description: Profile name

definition.name: sftp-upload-file
definition.description: Upload a local file to the remote host over SFTP, streaming it without passing the contents through model context. The local file must be inside the transferRoot directory the operator configured; without that setting this tool refuses. Use this for binary or large files; use sftp-upload for short text you already have.

localPath.description: Local file to upload, inside defaults.transferRoot

remotePath.description: Remote destination path. No leading or trailing whitespace, and no control, bidirectional or zero-width characters.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing remote file (default false)

mode.description: Remote file mode, 1 to 511 (0o777); setuid, setgid and the sticky bit are refused. e.g. 420 for 0644. Omit for 0600 on a new file, or the replaced file’s permission bits.

profile.description: Profile name

definition.name: signal-process
definition.description: Send a signal (INT, TERM, KILL) to a remote process by PID.

profile.description: Profile name

resources.description: List all SSH profiles and their connection status

resource_templates.description: Get details for a specific SSH profile

resource_templates.name: session
resource_templates.description: Get metadata for a specific session

definition.name: tavily_crawl
definition.description: Crawl a website starting from a URL. Extracts content from pages with configurable depth and breadth.

url.description: The root URL to begin the crawl

max_depth.description: Max depth of the crawl. Defines how far from the base URL the crawler can explore.

max_breadth.description: Max number of links to follow per level of the tree (i.e., per page)

limit.description: Total number of links the crawler will process before stopping

instructions.description: Natural language instructions for the crawler. Instructions specify which types of pages the crawler should return.

select_paths.description: Regex patterns to select only URLs with specific path patterns (e.g., /docs/.*, /api/v1.*)

select_domains.description: Regex patterns to restrict crawling to specific domains or subdomains (e.g., ^docs\.example\.com$)

allow_external.description: Whether to return external links in the final response

extract_depth.description: Advanced extraction retrieves more data, including tables and embedded content, with higher success but may increase latency

format.description: The format of the extracted web page content. markdown returns content in markdown format. text returns plain text and may increase latency.

include_favicon.description: Whether to include the favicon URL for each result

definition.name: tavily_extract
definition.description: Extract content from URLs. Returns raw page content in markdown or text format.

urls.description: List of URLs to extract content from

extract_depth.description: Use 'advanced' for LinkedIn, protected sites, or tables/embedded content

format.description: Output format

query.description: Query to rerank content chunks by relevance

definition.name: tavily_map
definition.description: Map a website's structure. Returns a list of URLs found starting from the base URL.

url.description: The root URL to begin the mapping

max_depth.description: Max depth of the mapping. Defines how far from the base URL the crawler can explore

max_breadth.description: Max number of links to follow per level of the tree (i.e., per page)

limit.description: Total number of links the crawler will process before stopping

instructions.description: Natural language instructions for the crawler

select_paths.description: Regex patterns to select only URLs with specific path patterns (e.g., /docs/.*, /api/v1.*)

select_domains.description: Regex patterns to restrict crawling to specific domains or subdomains (e.g., ^docs\.example\.com$)

allow_external.description: Whether to return external links in the final response

definition.name: tavily_research
definition.description: Perform comprehensive research on a given topic or question. Use this tool when you need to gather information from multiple sources to answer a question or complete a task. Returns a detailed response based on the research findings. Rate limit: 20 requests per minute.

input.description: A comprehensive description of the research task

model.description: Defines the degree of depth of the research. 'mini' is good for narrow tasks with few subtopics. 'pro' is good for broad tasks with many subtopics. 'auto' automatically selects the best model.

definition.name: tavily_search
definition.description: Search the web for current information on any topic. Use for news, facts, or data beyond your knowledge cutoff. Returns snippets and source URLs.

query.description: Search query

search_depth.description: The depth of the search. 'basic' for generic results, 'advanced' for more thorough search, 'fast' for optimized low latency with high relevance, 'ultra-fast' for prioritizing latency above all else

topic.description: The category of the search. This will determine which of our agents will be used for the search

time_range.description: The time range back from the current date to include in the search results

start_date.description: Will return all results after the specified start date. Required to be written in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Will return all results before the specified end date. Required to be written in the format YYYY-MM-DD

max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return

include_images.description: Include a list of query-related images in the response

include_image_descriptions.description: Include a list of query-related images and their descriptions in the response

include_raw_content.description: Include the cleaned and parsed HTML content of each search result

include_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results, if the user asks to search on specific sites set this to the domain of the site

exclude_domains.description: List of domains to specifically exclude, if the user asks to exclude a domain set this to the domain of the site

country.description: Boost search results from a specific country. Must be a full country name (e.g., 'United States', 'Japan', 'Germany'). ISO country codes (e.g., 'us', 'jp') are not supported. Available only if topic is general. See https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/search for the full list of supported countries.

include_favicon.description: Whether to include the favicon URL for each result

exact_match.description: Only return results containing the exact phrase(s) in quotes in your query
